verdict.rationale: BigQuery's first-party docs describe Colab Enterprise notebooks built into BigQuery that combine SQL queries with Python code, rich text, and visualizations, with end-to-end workflows in a single interface. That covers mixing SQL and Python against warehouse data with charts in the notebook. missing for 10: explicit documentation that query results and charts render inline in cells, independent or hands-on corroboration of the notebook experience.

support.subject: As an analyst, first-party notebooks let me mix SQL and Python against warehouse data, with results and charts inline

citations.quote: notebooks let you combine SQL queries with Python code, rich text, and visualizations to tell a comprehensive story with your data.
Colab Enterprise notebooks in BigQuery let you perform end-to-end data science and machine learning workflows within a single, integrated interface.
End-to-end ML workflows: build, evaluate, and deploy a BigQuery ML model within a single notebook interface.
